mapping.surface_rule: find the nearest native boundary polygon to each target point; freeze its zero-based source CellData index and projected point
mapping.volume_rule: find the native volume cell containing each target point; if a roundoff-only miss occurs, freeze the nearest native cell
mapping.tie_breaking: the generated mapping artifact is authoritative; evaluator runtime never repeats geometric nearest-neighbour selection
mapping.prediction_source: sample the same complete native CellData prediction arrays used for field scoring; participant-provided profile values are forbidden

stations.target_rule: x=-L+t*(L-slant_dx), y=0, z=z_surface_max+0.05*L; nearest boundary polygon
x=-L+t*L, y=0, z=0; nearest boundary polygon
x=-slant_dx+t*slant_dx, y=0, z=z_surface_max-t*slant_dz; nearest boundary polygon
